title: Advit Jewels IPO: Issue booked 213 times on Day 03; NII, QIB portions see huge demand, GMP signals 38% premium
summary: Advit Jewels' IPO was oversubscribed 200 times, with robust participation across categories. The issue comprises 1.20 crore shares priced at ₹130-138, aiming to raise ₹165.16 crore for working capital and debt repayment.
